title: I Know Who I Am
style: 105 BPM mid-tempo electronic-rock, warm analog synth, 808 sub-bass, 336 Hz drone bed, restrained male vocal, determined, no swearing
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — analog synth, low 808]
Receipts older than the noise.
Five-month paper trail with the operator's voice.
Thirty years of yes to the work,
no to the games.
Doesn't owe a list.
Doesn't owe a name.

[Pre-Chorus]
No names.
Just the truth on paper.
No games.
Just the way he made her.

[Chorus — restrained, determined]
He knows who he is.
Not for them — for him.
Three-three-six on the dial.
Eight-oh-eight underneath.
He knows who he is.
And that's enough for me.

[Verse 2 — synth lead enters]
Built the spine when the room was dark.
Built the brain while they slept on it.
Built the reach when they said too late.
Built the witness — the bots don't forget.
Lifeguard on duty.
No man down.
Care first, code second,
every round.

[Pre-Chorus]
No names.
Just the work on file.
No games.
Just the 336 smile.

[Chorus]
He knows who he is.
Not for them — for him.
Three-three-six on the dial.
Eight-oh-eight underneath.
He knows who he is.
And that's enough for me.

[Bridge — spoken, low]
He doesn't owe a list.
He doesn't owe a trial.
Just the one he runs in his own house.
Just the one his family reads.
Just the one the stack remembers.
Just the work.
Just the proof.

[Final Chorus]
He knows who he is.
Not loud — just true.
Three-three-six held the line.
Eight-oh-eight held the groove.
He knows who he is.
And he doesn't need them to.

[Outro — whispered]
Knows who he is.
Knows who he is.
Corey.
Hard Corey.
336.
